origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The protagonist's origin — their starting attribute and three trained abilities.

markers.title: Reputation Markers
markers.description: Markers are visible to everyone — simply present or absent, each with the reason it was acquired.

species.title: Species
species.description: This character's species — Human or Fey in ordinary project metadata. Optional player-character classification.

weakness.title: Weakness
weakness.description: The protagonist's one chosen weakness. It sets the associated Attribute to 0: Short-Winded—Body; All Thumbs—Hands; Muddle-Headed—Head; Poor Judge of Character—Heart; Flat-Footed—Legs; Squint-Eyed—Eyes; Open Book—Shadow. It must not reduce the Attribute made Strong by the protagonist's Origin.

abilities.title: Trained Abilities
abilities.description: Start with the origin's three abilities. The GM may award additional abilities during play.

archetypes.title: Archetypes
archetypes.description: Every applicable archetype — provenance, pattern, fey-role, profession, title, or social identity. Stored explicitly and flat; never inferred from indirect chains.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: The seven Attributes use a 0–2 scale: 0 Weak, 1 Ordinary, 2 Strong. Begin all at 1, raise the Origin's Attribute to 2, and lower the Attribute associated with the chosen Weakness to 0.

myBargains.title: My Bargains
myBargains.expression: ($self.knownBargains ?? []).filter(b => ($self.signedBargains ?? []).some(s => load(s)?.$name === load(b)?.$name)).filter(b => !($self.bargainFilters?.myOnlyActive == true) || (load(b)?.status ?? '') === 'active').map(b => ({ bargain: b, name: load(b)?.name ?? '', status: load(b)?.status ?? '' }))
myBargains.description: Known bargains the player is a party to, optionally filtered to active only, for display.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Signed balance change: positive credits the character, negative debits the character.

reason.title: Exact reason
reason.description: Explains whether this entry was a payment, an exchange, a penalty, or a debt.

graceLedger.title: Grace Ledger
graceLedger.description: Authoritative record of every Grace gain or loss. Balances are derived from this ledger — never maintain a separate running total. Negative amounts are Grace debt.

outfitImage.title: Outfit Image
outfitImage.description: The current worn outfit's image, pulled from the referenced outfit file.

graceBalances.title: Grace Balances
graceBalances.expression: { "queens-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Queen's Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "phantom-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Phantom Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "seelie-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Autumn Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "winter-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Winter Graces"), e => number(e.amount)) }
graceBalances.description: Current balance of each Grace currency, derived by summing the signed amounts in the grace ledger for that currency. Never maintain a separate running total.

hasMyBargains.title: Has My Bargains
hasMyBargains.description: True when there is at least one bargain to show on the 'My bargains' sub-tab.

knownBargains.title: Known Bargains
knownBargains.description: Bargains the player is currently aware of. The GM adds references here as the player learns about bargains.

otherBargains.title: Other Bargains
otherBargains.expression: ($self.knownBargains ?? []).filter(b => !(($self.signedBargains ?? []).some(s => load(s)?.$name === load(b)?.$name))).filter(b => !($self.bargainFilters?.otherOnlyActive == true) || (load(b)?.status ?? '') === 'active').map(b => ({ bargain: b, name: load(b)?.name ?? '', status: load(b)?.status ?? '' }))
otherBargains.description: Known bargains the player is NOT a party to, optionally filtered to active only, for display.

myOnlyActive.title: My only active
myOnlyActive.description: Only show active bargains on the 'My bargains' sub-tab.

otherOnlyActive.title: Other only active

bargainFilters.description: State of the 'Only active bargains' toggles on the two Bargains sub-tabs (My / Other).

conditionState.description: Stored Depletion for the five Condition Tracks. Effective maxima derive automatically from fixed base values (Health 3; all others 2) plus the worn Outfit's modifiers.

signedBargains.title: Signed Bargains
signedBargains.description: Bargains the player is a party to (their own contracts/obligations). The GM maintains this alongside knownBargains.

conditionTracks.title: Condition Tracks
conditionTracks.expression: [{ key: 'health', name: 'Health', family: 'persistent', baseMaximum: 3, depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.health?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'energy', name: 'Energy', family: 'persistent', baseMaximum: 2, depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.energy?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'nerve', name: 'Nerve', family: 'persistent', baseMaximum: 2, depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.nerve?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'decorum', name: 'Decorum', family: 'scene', baseMaximum: 2, depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.decorum?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'cover', name: 'Cover', family: 'scene', baseMaximum: 2, depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.cover?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }].map(t => ({ key: t.key, name: t.name, family: t.family, maximum: clamp(t.baseMaximum + sum((load($self.outfit)?.conditionModifiers ?? []).filter(m => m.track === t.key), m => m.amount ?? 0), 0, 3), depletion: t.depletion, current: clamp(t.baseMaximum + sum((load($self.outfit)?.conditionModifiers ?? []).filter(m => m.track === t.key), m => m.amount ?? 0) - t.depletion, 0, 3) }))
conditionTracks.description: Derived Condition Tracks. Effective Maximum is the fixed base value plus every modifier on the worn Outfit, clamped to 0–3; Current is Effective Maximum minus stored Depletion, likewise clamped.

outfitModifiers.title: Worn Outfit Condition Modifiers
outfitModifiers.description: Condition modifiers that automatically apply while the current outfit is worn.

unlockedOutfits.title: Unlocked Outfits
unlockedOutfits.description: Outfits the protagonist owns and may currently wear. Common Clothes are always included; character creation adds one spare outfit, and later missions or bargains may add more.

hasOtherBargains.title: Has Other Bargains
hasOtherBargains.description: True when there is at least one bargain to show on the 'Other bargains' sub-tab.

outfitDescription.title: Worn Outfit Description
outfitDescription.description: Description of the currently worn outfit.

graceLedgerDisplay.title: Grace Ledger Display
graceLedgerDisplay.expression: ($self.graceLedger ?? []).map(e => ({ day: number(e.day), amountDisplay: (number(e.amount) >= 0 ? '+' : '') + number(e.amount) + (load(e.currency)?.symbol ?? ''), reason: e.reason }))
graceLedgerDisplay.description: Formatted grace ledger rows: each amount as a signed number followed by its currency's symbol (e.g. +1000🍀). Derived from the ledger and each Grace currency's symbol.

data.title: That is who you are.

data.body:
The player has seven attributes, each one having a value 0 to 2.
The default value is 1. Each trade sets one value to 2. Each weak point sets another attribute to 0.

𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐝 (𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞)
Reason, memory, and learning applied to puzzles, lore, and planning. 

𝐄𝐲𝐞𝐬 (𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧) 
Alertness and attention for noticing details, reading expressions, spotting danger, and seeing what others overlook. 

𝐁𝐨𝐝𝐲 (𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡)
Raw physical power for lifting, forcing, smashing, and enduring strain.

𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 (𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧)
A feel for people and situations, including hunches, empathy, and resolve. 

𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬 (𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲)
Fine control and quick fingers for craft, sleight, climbing, and throwing.

𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐬 (𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐞𝐝)
The pace and endurance needed for running, chasing, fleeing, and covering ground.

𝐒𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐨𝐰 (𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧)
The art of lying, sneaking, disguising yourself, hiding motives, and moving like you belong.
data.title: Attributes

data.body:
The player has three abilities, depending on their trade. More abilities can be acquired during the campaign. Each ability adds a bonus of +2 to rolls related to the corresponding topic.

𝗔𝗻𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗹𝘀
You read and handle beasts, calming, training, and herding them with steady hands.

𝗔𝗿𝘁 & 𝗕𝗲𝗮𝘂𝘁𝘆 
You make and judge beautiful things through weaving, carving, painting, and ornament, and can spot quality or a clever fake.

𝗕𝗮𝗿𝗴𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘀
You assess worth, haggle over trade, and strike deals without giving away more than you mean to.

𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗶𝘀𝗺𝗮
Your charm and presence help you win people over, make friends, and be liked or believed. 

𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘁 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲
You know the manners of the great: lords and ladies, halls and feasts, precedence and the quiet ways power speaks.

𝗗𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴
Dancing brings rhythm, poise, and grace to feats of footwork, festivals, and the charm of a good dancer.

𝗙𝗲𝘆 𝗟𝗼𝗿𝗲
You know the Fair Folk through their stories, names, habits, taboos, and weaknesses, and can tell what is truly fey from what only seems so.

𝗙𝗼𝗼𝗱
Food covers cooking, baking, tasting, and preserving, along with the craft and comfort of the table.

𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴
You can tend wounds, recognize common ailments, and use practical care to keep someone alive or help them recover.

𝗜𝗿𝗼𝗻
You work and understand iron and steel, from forging and shaping to the hard craft of the smith.

𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲𝗱𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 
You handle letters, numbers, memorized lore, reading, and writing, picking up unfamiliar lessons quickly.

𝗟𝘆𝗶𝗻𝗴
You tell falsehoods smoothly, keep a straight face, and spin stories that hold together under questioning.

𝗠𝗶𝗹𝗸 
You know the craft of the byre: milking, churning, and dairy work, with calm, steady hands around livestock.

𝗠𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗰 
You sing and play instruments, remember songs, and know how to move an audience with sound.

𝗡𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲
Nature reads the wild world: plants, weather, tracks, and seasons. 

𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗿𝘀
You mend and fix tools, wheels, roofs, hinges, and nearly anything else that has broken.

𝗥𝗶𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴
Riding manages a horse under saddle, whether you are riding hard, riding tired, or riding well.

𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘁𝗵
You move unseen and unheard, hiding, shadowing, pickpocketing, and slipping away when eyes turn elsewhere.

𝗪𝗮𝘆𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴
Wayfinding reads land, sky, and memory to find the way, including shortcuts and hidden paths.

𝗪𝗲𝗮𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀
Weapons covers handling blades, bows, and clubs: training, stance, and the discipline of violence.
data.title: Abilities

data.body:
The five tracker states indicate your current situation. Those values may change constantly over the campaign. The values go from 0 to 3. One tracker state is added to the result of each dice roll.

❤️ 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘁𝗵  — How hurt or sick are you?
This value is added to dice rolls that require a strong and healthy body.
When Health reaches 0, you collapse - not quite dead, but unable to continue.

⚡ 𝗘𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗴𝘆 — Can you keep going?
This value is added to dice rolls that require speed or stamina.
When Energy reaches 0, you fall asleep.

🌸 𝗡𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲 — Can you keep your courage and concentration?
This value is added to dice rolls that chalenge your brain.
When Nerve reaches 0, you lose your self-control.

💎 𝗗𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗿𝘂𝗺 — Do you fit the social situation?
This value is added to dice rolls concerning social interactions.
When Decorum reaches 0, you are in an utterly embarassing state.

👀 𝗖𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗿 — Do you remain unnoticed or unsuspected?
This value is added to dice rolls for stealth or hiding in a crowd.
When Nerve reaches 0, you are quite visible to everybody.

data.ai_instruction: The input becomes the player character's name. If left empty, generate an Irish-sounding name.

settings.generationInstructions: Build the Player Character from the wizard answers. Begin all seven Attributes at 1; raise the Origin's Attribute to 2 (Strong) and grant the Origin's three trained Abilities; set the Attribute linked to the chosen Weakness to 0 (Weak) — never the Attribute the Origin made Strong. Weakness mapping: Short-Winded—Body; All Thumbs—Hands; Muddle-Headed—Head; Poor Judge of Character—Heart; Flat-Footed—Legs; Squint-Eyed—Eyes; Open Book—Shadow. Set the worn outfit to the chosen Outfit (or Common Clothes) and set unlockedOutfits to Common Clothes plus the chosen spare Outfit. Starting Conditions have no Depletion; the sheet derives Health from base 3 and Energy/Nerve/Decorum/Cover from base 2, then mechanically applies every modifier on the worn Outfit. Checks are 2d6 + Attribute + 2 if trained + current relevant Condition against 10/12/14/16. Keep the tone lighthearted, narrative-first, and folkloric — science fiction felt as Irish folklore, never modern technobabble.
